overall_package_height.interpretation: Side-view arrows extend from solder-ball seating envelope to the package top. Title and ordering chart use 1.1 mm, the upper limit, rather than nominal height.

ball_pitch.qualifier: TYP; drawing supplies no separate plus/minus pitch tolerance

ball_protrusion_below_package.interpretation: Package underside to ball seating envelope, from the side-view arrows. This is package ball height, not a separately specified PCB-mounted joint standoff.

coplanarity_callout.interpretation: Drawing shows a surface-profile tolerance frame 0.08 relative to datum A at the ball seating plane. Do not rewrite as a plus/minus height tolerance or an unrelated body-flatness specification.

drawing_pad_note: Dimensions apply to solder balls post-reflow on Ø0.40 SMD ball pads.

pad_note_interpretation.drawing_context: Package Dimensions; the note directly qualifies the 200-ball diameter callout on the package view.
pad_note_interpretation.conclusion: The note defines package solder-ball geometry with the package ball-pad condition. It does not specify a PCB copper-land diameter, PCB solder-mask opening, paste aperture, or complete recommended PCB land pattern.
pad_note_interpretation.limits: The package drawing alone does not authorize a Ø0.40 PCB copper pad or establish PCB-mounted solder-joint height. PCB geometry requires a separately selected SMD/NSMD construction and assembly/land-pattern validation.
pad_note_interpretation.full_datasheet_text_search: No occurrence of PCB, land pattern, board layout, or a separate PCB pad recommendation found. SMD occurrences are in package descriptions and package dimension drawings.

ordering_crosscheck.package_code: FW = 200-ball TFBGA 10 x 14.5 x 1.1 mm, Ø0.40 SMD
ordering_crosscheck.AT: Operating case temperature TC -40 to +105 degrees C
ordering_crosscheck.qualification_limit: The source itself instructs users to verify valid part numbers with the Micron product catalog; this review does not establish current orderability.
